criteria.title: Trace a draft to its source
criteria.startingState: A draft references a source PDF and the reviewer has access.
actions: Backend: Read back the saved document reference.
criteria.expectedResult: The exact source PDF attached to the draft opens.

criteria.title: Restrict access to the source PDF
criteria.startingState: A draft references a source PDF and a user lacks read access.
actions: The user requests the document link.
Backend: Inspect the service response for the restricted role.
criteria.expectedResult: The request is denied and the user receives no document link.
